title: 含 CCCS 的正弦稳态电路：结点方程的矩阵形式
statement: 正弦稳态电路如图，ω = 1000 rad/s，V̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），R_1 = 5 Ω，C = 200 µF，L = 10 mH，R_4 = 10 Ω。电流控制电流源 F 的电流为 2i_C（向下），i_C 为电容电流（向下）。

支路：1 = V_s 串 R_1（由 3 指向 1），2 = C（1→3），3 = L（1→2），4 = R_4 并 F（2→3）；结点 3 为参考结点，A 的行为结点 1、2。标准支路（复合支路）约定：支路 k 的电压 V_k、电流 I_k 取支路方向（关联），İ_k = Y_k(V̇_k + V̇_sk) − İ_sk；V_sk 的“+”极在支路终点一侧（推动电流沿支路方向流动）时为正，I_sk 的方向与支路方向**相反**时为正。CCCS 按教材处理：支路 k 中的 β·İ_ej（İ_ej 为支路 j 中无源元件的电流 = Y_j·V̇_ej）使 Y_kj = ±β·Y_j。
写出 A、Y，求 Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ 的元素，并解出结点电压。

questions.ask: 支路导纳矩阵 Y 的元素 Y_42 的虚部 = ?
questions.explain: F 的电流 β·İ_C = β·Y_2·V̇_2 = 2 × j0.2 × V̇_2：Y_42 = β·Y_2 = j0.4 S（F 向下与支路 4 同向，i_C 向下与支路 2 同向，取 +）。

questions.ask: Y_n 的元素 Y_11 的虚部 = ?
电容电流 i_C 的有效值 = ?

hints: CCCS 先换成“受电压控制”：İ_C = jωC·V̇_2，所以 Y_42 = β·jωC。
Y_n 是 2 × 2 复数矩阵，用克拉默法则：V̇_n2 = (Y_11·J_2 − Y_21·J_1)/Δ，J_n = (2, 0)ᵀ A。

en.title: AC circuit with a CCCS: node equations in matrix form
statement: Sinusoidal steady state, ω = 1000 rad/s, V̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), R_1 = 5 Ω, C = 200 µF, L = 10 mH, R_4 = 10 Ω. The current-controlled current source F carries 2i_C (downwards), i_C being the capacitor current (downwards).

Branches: 1 = V_s in series with R_1 (from 3 to 1), 2 = C (1→3), 3 = L (1→2), 4 = R_4 in parallel with F (2→3); node 3 is the reference, rows of A = nodes 1, 2. Standard (composite) branch convention: V_k and I_k follow the branch direction (associated), İ_k = Y_k(V̇_k + V̇_sk) − İ_sk; V_sk is positive when its "+" is toward the end of the branch (it pushes current along the branch), and I_sk is positive when it points **against** the branch direction. The CCCS as in the textbook: β·İ_ej in branch k (İ_ej = current of the passive element of branch j = Y_j·V̇_ej) gives Y_kj = ±β·Y_j.
Write A and Y, find entries of Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ and solve for the node voltages.

questions.ask: Imaginary part of entry Y_42 of the branch admittance matrix = ?
questions.explain: F carries β·İ_C = β·Y_2·V̇_2 = 2 × j0.2 × V̇_2: Y_42 = β·Y_2 = j0.4 S (F points down along branch 4 and i_C down along branch 2, so +).

questions.ask: Imaginary part of entry Y_11 of Y_n = ?

questions.explain: Without the CCCS Y_21 = −1/(jωL) = j0.1; the controlled term a_24·Y_42·a_12 = (1)(j0.4)(1) = j0.4 gives j0.5 S. Y_12 stays j0.1.

questions.ask: rms value of the capacitor current i_C = ?

hints: Branch admittances: 1/R_1 = 0.2 S, jωC = j0.2 S, 1/(jωL) = −j0.1 S, 1/R_4 = 0.1 S.
Turn the CCCS into a voltage-controlled one first: İ_C = jωC·V̇_2, so Y_42 = β·jωC.
Y_n is a 2 × 2 complex matrix; with Cramer's rule V̇_n2 = (Y_11·J_2 − Y_21·J_1)/Δ, J_n = (2, 0)ᵀ A.
solution: **Check (KCL at node 2):** in through L: −j0.1(V̇_n1 − V̇_n2) ≈ 1.015 − j0.123 A; out through R_4: 0.1·V̇_n2 ≈ 0.154 − j1.231 A and F: 2İ_C ≈ 0.862 + j1.108 A, summing to 1.015 − j0.123 A ✓.
